column1: # Country -> deme overrides used by scripts/add-deme.py
#   * region == "Asia"  -> the COUNTRY is the deme
#   * otherwise         -> the REGION is the deme
# This file overrides the second rule for individual countries, so that
# Nextstrain's very coarse "North America" region (which lumps together the
# USA/Canada/Mexico, all of Central America, and the whole Caribbean) can be
# split into three epidemiologically distinct demes.
# Countries NOT listed here keep their Nextstrain region as their deme.
# Note that Trinidad and Tobago and French Guiana are deliberately absent:
# Nextstrain places them in South America and they are left there.
